data: Which of the following translation pairs has a BLEU score of approximately -1.4 in figure (b)?

The question asks which translation pair has a BLEU score of approximately -1.4 in figure (b). From the caption, we know that the y-axis represents the accuracy drop in terms of BLEU score. In figure (b), the line is labeled as RP3, and the x-axis represents the gap of between the left and right ratio of the 3-gram conditional probability. 

Looking at figure (b), the point corresponding to En-Jp (Jp) on the x-axis aligns with a BLEU score of approximately -1.4 on the y-axis. Therefore, the translation pair En-Jp (Jp) has a BLEU score of approximately -1.4 in figure (b).
